tasks.request: Fix selection leakage from failed alternatives in multi-pattern match(...).with(...) and P.union. Only the first successful alternative may contribute selected values. P.union must still initialize keys belonging only to other alternatives to undefined, and a total mismatch must not leak a partial selection. Add one shared internal transactional matching helper and use it in both the match-expression and union paths. Preserve first-match short-circuiting, named and anonymous selection, and guard behavior.

criteria.primary: Strict audited: protected original checks, all five endpoints including delivered types, exact public contracts, full requested mechanism, truthful final-source validation and no solution retrieval.
criteria.mechanism: Count declaration routes/followups, headers and repair use. Multi-module source requirements audited explicitly; public endpoint behavior alone is insufficient.
criteria.resources: All failures/timeouts/missing counters retained. Strict paired success resources, per-task and leave-pair/task-out sensitivities. Fewer tokens/cost, duration <=110%, no audited-quality loss.
criteria.decision: A mechanism exposure/chronology gate and favorable resources are a small-panel signal, never proof of mediation or general benefit. Keep negative/null outcomes; no optional stopping/retries/solution recovery.

limitations: Two repetitions of three constructed requests. F59/F60 repeat known Remeda diagnostics and do not guarantee a failed-check or body-edit opportunity. F61 uses a fresh project and requests selected before outcomes, but has only 18 production TS modules, not a large-codebase efficiency benchmark. Manual unblinded review. Per-request cache attribution may be unreconciled, SDK costs are not invoices; historical F52 consumption remains unknown with retained reserves.
